Every Friday since 2019

This is what Friday looks like.

Every call opens the same way: around the table, each of us shares a gratitude, a gap and a focus for the week. Then come hot seats, demos and whichever rabbit hole is worth going down.

Our mission

Empowering digital entrepreneurs to grow together with generosity, dependability and fun.

A non-profit society that brings masters of their craft together to take SEO to the next level in results, business and lifestyle. Not just tactics, but the strategic frameworks behind them.

Greater together.

On the table this year

A brotherhood built on shared knowledge.

Nobody builds on their own island. What one member builds in the lab, the rest of us test, push back on and help get dialed in, so ideas are proven on real accounts before they reach yours.

01

Autonomous SEO agents

Agents that build pages, fix errors and ship client sites in days, with no one at the keyboard.

02

AI search visibility

What gets a brand cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Google’s AI answers, and how to prove who published it first.

03

Schema and entities at scale

Machine-readable sites that search engines and AI models understand without guessing.

04

Building the AI stack

Which models, tools and hardware are worth paying for, and how to keep token costs from running away.

05

Selling AI to clients

Packaging AI into services owners will pay for, including outcome-based deals.

06

Security for the AI era

Backups, hardening and agents that catch attacks before a client loses a lead.

07

Running great agencies

Sales, hiring and client service, including warrior mode when the pipeline slows.

08

Net worth and legacy

Turning agency profits into lasting wealth, and what we give back along the way.

For SEO experts

Your best ideas deserve a better room than a conference stage.

On stage, the audience takes notes and nobody pushes back. Share the real version in public and you give your edge away. At our table, twelve operators running live client work will pressure-test it, and it stays in the room.

01

Apply and present

Tell us what you’re working on. If it’s a fit, you present to the Dozen on a Friday and the room digs in.

02

Join the Master Council

Great guests stay connected with the group between sessions, alongside names like Kyle Roof and Dixon Jones.

03

Earn a seat

When a seat opens, the current members vote in a past guest from the Council. You don’t apply to join. You earn the invite and take your seat at the table.

Have something worth sharing?

Apply to present to the Dozen. It takes about two minutes, and every member started as a guest.

A member reads every application. You’ll hear back within a few days.

What you walk away with

Your idea, put to work Twelve agencies with live client accounts. Ideas that hold up get used, and you hear how they performed.
Your own hot seat Bring a problem you’re stuck on. Twelve operators will give you their best advice and share what’s worked for them.
Relationships that last Connections and referrals with established agency owners across the US and Canada.
A seat on the Master Council Stay connected with the group, and be in the running when a seat opens.
Off the record Everything said at the table is confidential. Sessions are recorded for members only. Nothing is published, posted or passed on outside the group. What you share is used to help, never repeated.

Questions

Good to know.

When and where do you meet?

Every Friday at 8:30 a.m. Pacific (11:30 a.m. Eastern), on Zoom.

What does a guest session look like?

We start with a quick round of introductions, about 10 to 15 minutes. Then the floor is yours for 30 minutes or so. The last 20 to 30 minutes are open discussion and your hot seat.

Do I need a polished presentation?

No. This isn’t a conference stage, and it’s pretty informal. Bring the knowledge you’d share in a room of trusted peers but wouldn’t put in front of a hundred people: a test, a workflow, a tool. Slides are optional.

Can I share something I’m building?

Yes. Guests often beta-launch or beta-test their products with us. It’s a highly technical room, so expect sharp questions and ideas you can use.

Does it cost anything to present?

No. Presenting is free.

What happens after I apply?

We read every application and you’ll hear back from us within a few days.

Will my session be shared?

No. Sessions are recorded for members only. Everything said at the table is confidential and is never published, posted or passed on.

How do I join the Dozen?

You don’t apply to join. Guests present first and join our Master Council. When a seat opens, the current members vote in a new member from the Council.
